rank_method: pandas same-date average rank pct=True; centered=2*rank/n-1; N<2 ineligible
rank_population: each factor's finite same-date causal-eligible cross-section before joint intersection
insufficient_joint_cross_section: fewer than 4 joint observations cannot identify four-column design; ineligible and reported
near_zero_variance: sample variance ddof=1 <= 1e-12; zero/undefined product variation excluded from eligible compute but retained in pre-exclusion diagnostic denominators
condition_number: 2-norm raw frozen rank-design [1,x,z,x*z], no standardization alternative
vif: each of the three non-intercept columns regressed on intercept and the other two; 1/(1-R2); degenerate or exact collinearity => infinity
blocks: four approximately equal chronological dates with at least 4 finite jointly eligible inputs, fixed before variance/design diagnostic exclusion; report excluded dates
rank_deficient_and_near_zero_fraction_de: all dates with >=4 jointly finite causal inputs, before diagnostic exclusion; missing/insufficient input dates reported separately
leverage: predictor-only projection diagonal from SVD; conventional descriptive flag h>2*rank/n; not a feasibility gate
gates: unchanged frozen thresholds, independent eight verdicts
